balls.text: yorker jammed out on middle stump back to Nortje. They don't even attempt to run off the final ball. Hmmm.... Nothing like a red inker!
knee high full toss on an attempted yorker at 145 kph, spooned over Nortje's leaping effort to long-off for two.
full length slower ball at 125 kph on fourth stump, Hetmyer not fooled and pumps this high over long-off into the dugout.
length ball on the hips, goes to pull and flubs the shot well short of deep fine leg bouncing in front for one.
low full toss on off, slapped down the ground for one.
into the second tier over midwicket! Length ball on fourth stump, heaves a pull over the leg side landing 96 meters back off the front of the mezzanine.
yorker on leg stump at 134 kph, flicked out to wide long-on for one.
yorker at 133 kph on middle jammed out back down the pitch for one.
hello! What a shot to get off the mark! Offcutter lands as a half-volley on middle and leg, whipped nonchalantly over wide midwicket thudding into the LCD ad boards.

yorker on middle at 134 kph, jammed out back to the bowler. Mukesh fires back at Buttler for a runout chance at the stumps that misses. Warner is appealing for a catch believing this was not a bump ball.  Indeed the replays show this was not jammed off into the ground but rather bounced first and came off the toe floating back to Mukesh. He juggled it initially before taking the catch on the rebound. It came back to Mukesh at rib height to his left and he stabbed at it initially to pop it further up into the air before taking it on a second effort. Rather than celebrating a catch though, he fired at the stumps for a runout. It was really Warner who appealed for the catch. Bizarre sequence but Buttler's innings finally ends.
slower length ball outside leg at 115 kph, Hetmyer miscues another heave that dribbles to deep square leg for one.
half-volley outside leg at 133 kph, Hetmyer clears the front leg and winds up to deposit this high and deep 12 rows back over backward square leg.
knee high full toss at 141 kph on off stump, Nortje misfires on the attempted yorker and Buttler muscles this shot over mid-off to the rope.
slower length ball at 133 kph on fourth stump, Buttler premeditates a reverse pull and misses.
yorker speared into the legs following him backing away, flicked to deep backward square for two.

length ball on fourth stump, Buttler shuffles across to scoop this 146 kph delivery over fine leg to the rope. Hard to believe everyone lost their minds when Mal Loye was playing wild shots against Australia in a T20I for England 15+ years ago. Now such shots are so commonplace that everyone shrugs their shoulders at Buttler's execution to 146 kph/90 mph pace.

dropped! thigh high full toss flicked by Hetmyer a mile high over midwicket. Almost caught off guard by this delivery and no footwork or leg drive into the shot. The fielder charges in from the rope 25 yards and dives forward getting two hands to it but it bursts through in the end for them to take a single.
full and angled in on fifth stump at 146 kph, Hetmyer winds up and misses a booming drive.
full and wide low full toss at 120 kph, toe-slaps this to the cover sweeper for one.
knee high full toss on the wide guideline at 118 kph, Hetmyer flays this flat to the fielder on the ring at extra cover for none.
full and very wide, drives this inside out over extra cover to the rope.
full on fifth stump at 119 kph, Hetmyer shuffles across and launches this high over the long-on rope.
full on fifth stump, shuffles well across the stumps to heave this to deep midwicket for one.
low full toss is slammed flat to long-on. Catch taken by Axar Patel at waist height and he relays the free hit back into the middle to keep this to just a single.
full and wide outside off, wide called initially. But the siren goes off to turn a wide into a no ball and a free hit.
goes for yorker again at 137 kph, this time winds up as a half-volley on the stumps that Buttler smokes back down the pitch to the rope.
full toss at shin height on fourth stump at 134 kph, Mukesh misfires on the length going for yorker and Buttler punishes him with an elegant flick ramp over fine leg to the rope.
full on fifth stump, flicked to wide long-on for one.
yorker on middle, flicked to deep midwicket for one.
full and speared into the legs, late on a flick and it dribbles off the pads into the leg side for an extra.
full on fourth stump, punched to mid-off for one.
short on the stumps, pulled to long-on for one.
good length ball on fifth stump, tapped to extra cover for none.
length ball on sixth stump, slapped to extra cover for one.
full on fifth stump, reverse sweeps this straight to backward point for none.
full and wide on seventh stump, slices a lofted drive over extra cover for two before long-off cuts it off.
short and wide, bottom edges a cut into the off side for none.
full on fifth stump, defended to cover.
bullseye! Full on off stump tailing in a touch. Parag heaves across the line and misses. Middle and off stump are split apart halfway up.
attempted slower ball floats in at waist height on middle, pulls this behind square leg for one. Called legal on field and Buttler opts against reviewing it for a no ball on height.
length ball on the stumps, driven down the ground for one.
good length ball on off, defended.
length ball down the leg side for a wide.
good length ball tapped away through the ring for one.
good length ball on fifth stump, tap and run into the covers for one.
length ball on sixth stump, tapped to long-off for one.
short on sixth stump, slapped to the sweeper for one.
good length ball on fifth stump, defended to cover.
length ball on fifth stump, Buttler muscles this high over wide long-on screeching over the hands of a ball-boy standing in front of the LCD ad boards. Buttler brings up a 32-ball half-century.
full on fourth stump, driven to long-on for one.
full on leg stump, another reverse sweep this time connected square to the point sweeper for two.
good length ball on off, punched to the off side ring for none.
full and wide on seventh stump, reverse sweeps this along the ground straight to short third for none.
good length ball outside off, sliced through cover for one.
good length ball on fourth stump, pulled to midwicket for one.
good length ball on middle, skids a touch low and a pull is dragged through midwicket for one.
good length ball on the stumps, flicked through midwicket for one.
short on seventh stump, sliced to the cover sweeper for one.
short and wide, punched square to the point sweeper for one.
back of a length on fourth stump, defended to cover.
speared in quicker and fuller on the legs, flicked through midwicket for one.
good length ball on off, defended.

leading edge nearly carries back to Kuldeep! Fullish length on middle, closes the face early going to flick to midwicket and it floats back toward the bowler who dives in front of the non-striker but it just barely short hops him.

floated full on sixth stump, skies this a mile high but well short of the long-on rope. Nortje has a much less adventurous effort required for this compared to the theatrical drop on the run on the Buttler chance earlier. Just waits for it to come down into his hands at neck height 15 yards in from the rope for a simple catch.
good length ball on fifth stump, tap and run into the covers for one.
good length on the legs, tap and run into vacant midwicket for a very well-placed two.
full and very wide, goes to drive and misses.
full on the stumps, flicked to wide long-on for two.
bouncer over fifth stump, left alone.
good length ball on the stumps at 134 kph, defended back down the pitch.
good length ball on middle, defended.

it's a miracle! AKA, a wicket! Back of a length on middle, Jaiswal comes down the track trying to bully another cross bat shot over the leg side but cramps himself coming too close to the ball and this lobs up off a top edge over the middle of the pitch. Mukesh calls for it and takes a simple catch to end a rollicking opening stand.
full on the stumps, flicked through midwicket for one.
comes down the track to a 131 kph delivery full on fifth stump, flicked through long-on to one.
drag-down quicker ball at 112 kph outside leg stump, Buttler not caught by surprise one bit and flicks a pull behind square leg to the rope.
full on middle, driven to long-on for one.
After a deluge of boundaries for 7+ overs, we finally have our first six! Full on leg stump, charges while backing away from leg to create room and launches this high and deep over long-off.
good length on the legs, tapped gently through midwicket for one.
length ball on the wide guideline, Buttler backs away to cut and a toe edge goes wide of the keeper and fine of short third man before going to the rope.
Jaiswal charges first ball floated full on middle and doesn't let it pitch, driving flat to long-off for one.
good length ball on the stumps, flicked gently into midwicket for one to keep the strike.
extraordinary placement! Length ball on fourth stump, flicks this through wide long-on splitting the boundary rider gap with deep midwicket and brings up a 25-ball half-century.His fifth IPL fifty.
length ball on seventh stump, sliced delicately behind point past a diving effort, beats Rossouw diving to his right at sweeper too.
good length ball on sixth stump, shuffles down the track before checking defensively back to Axar.
good length on middle and leg, flicked through midwicket for one.
good length on fifth stump, Jaiswal shuffles across and taps into mid-on for one.
132 kph good length ball on off, tapped defensively to extra cover for none.
good length ball wide outside off at 145 kph, sliced to backward point for none.
half-volley on fourth stump at 141 kph, spanked high over mid-off to the rope.
139 kph length ball on fourth stump, tapped short of mid-off for one.
length ball on fourth stump at 142 kph, defended to mid-off for none.
147 kph delivery speared full into the pads, beats him trying to flick this through midwicket and comes off the pads for none.
full on the stumps, driven to long-on for one.
knee high full toss outside leg, gets on a knee to sweep this before it pitches high over backward square leg to the rope.
good length ball well outside leg stump, Jaiswal backs away from the stumps almost off the pitch to create room to cut this through the gap between point and backward point to the rope.
full on fourth stump, Jaiswal goes for the reverse sweep this time to a ball zipped in at 101 kph and Jaiswal gets some glove on this to get it past the keeper to the third man rope.
slanted on a good length across sixth stump, goes to sweep again and misses.
full outside leg, sweeps this flat to square leg for none.

dropped! Slower ball lands full on middle, Buttler shovels this a mile high over mid-on. Nortje runs back 25+ yards from the circle and covers the distance to get his hands to an over the shoulder chance in stride but his head is bobbing up and down with the rest of his body going full bore for the chance and juggles this initially, tries to clutch onto it on a second effort but spills it further. 8/10 chance on difficulty but the hardest part was just getting to the ball and Nortje did that. He slams the turf in frustration as Buttler completes two.
full and speared way down the leg side at 135 kph, keeper barely gets a hand to it diving right to slow it down and prevent five wides but they still jog a second wide to put Buttler back on strike.
full outside leg, flicked to deep fine leg for one.

short and well down the leg side, wide called. Khaleel is upset and insisting that this came off the gloves bouncing short of the keeper on an attempted pull. Delhi signals for DRS trying to get the wide overturned... Khaleel's angst is justified, there's a spike on ultraedge off the glove. Wide rescinded. Shows how desperate Delhi is to not have to bowl an extra delivery with the way these two openers are going.
full on fifth stump at 140 kph, punched to mid-off and they hustle a single.
length ball on ninth stump, goes to slap this on the up and is beaten.
full and very wide on the wrong side of the wide guideline past an attempted drive, wide called.
length ball on eighth stump, sits up to be whacked with a cut through point.
length ball on fifth stump, sliced wide of deep third man, Khaleel slides along the rope to keep this to one.
135 kph delivery full on the legs, flicked straight to deep fine leg for one.
fullish length on fifth stump at 137 kph, shoveled on the up high over mid-off and goes one bounce over the rope.
good length ball on fifth stump at 135 kph, defended to mid-off for none.
heyyyyyyy it's a single! Length ball on off, tap and run to mid-off for a tight run.
good length ball on middle, defended.

good lord what timing! Buttler takes a length ball from fifth stump at 144 kph, and just pokes at it looking like he's wanting to place a single between cover and extra cover to keep strike for the next over, but he taps this with such incredible timing that it splits the gap in the ring and goes to the rope.
fullish length on seventh stump at 144 kph, drives this and slices this not completely in control over short third man to the rope.
half-volley on middle, whipped straight to midwicket for none.
136 kph length ball on sixth stump, flayed on the up through cover and finds the gap to the rope. Nortje lets loose with an expletive through the stump mic. He's not happy...
good length ball on off stump, defended again to cover.
back of a length on off at 143 kph, defended to the off side.
caresses this over short third! Back of a length on fifth stump, keeps the hands back late to flick this uppishly over the man in the ring and it skips away to the rope.
full on the stumps at 139 kph, driven high over the non-striker to the long-on rope.
full on sixth stump again, driven firmly to cover on the ring for none.
hat-trick of fours to start play! Half-volley on seventh stump at 137 kph, pumps a drive through extra cover to the rope.
clumsy at deep third man by Mukesh Kumar! Short on fifth stump at 132 kph, this time fights this off with a cut that is horribly misfielded by the man on the rope and turns one into four.
131 kph short on fourth stump, Jaiswal laces a pull over midwicket to the rope.
length ball on off stump, miscues a heave behind square leg for a tame single to end the match.
full on middle, charges and slices a drive to backward point for none.
full in the fifth stump channel, goes to drive and is beaten.
good length ball on off stump, punched to long-on for one.
bullseye! Slower length ball skids on low toward leg stump at 109 kph, Nortje flails awkwardly over the ball with his shot and the ball pings the outer half of leg stump 3/4 of the way up.
back of a length on leg stump, flicked into midwicket for one.

good length ball on middle, Warner goes to reverse/switch hit this and misses off the chest while crouching low. Big lbw shout.... Umpire takes five seconds..... and finally raises the finger. Warner goes for DRS immediately. Again, he was hit in the torso after missing the shot, the question is how how was he hit there considering he was crouching low. Ball-tracking shows he was indeed crouched very low, as three reds light up on the projection.
full on fifth stump, goes to drive and scuffs this out to long-off for one.
good length ball on leg stump, goes to reverse sweep this and misses as it spins past leg stump.
good length ball on the legs, flicked behind square leg for one.

floated full on leg stump, slogs this out to deep midwicket but not much power behind the shot and it floats to Hetmyer coming in 10 yards off the rope, who takes the catch sliding forward on his knees.
short on the stumps, shuffles across and pulls behind square for one.
full and wide, laces this high over extra cover, one bounce over the rope.
wide yorker on the guideline, sliced out to deep cover for one.
wide yorker on seventh stump, slapped to extra cover for none.
yorker dug out square for one.
full on middle, flicked out to wide long-on for one.
length ball on the body, goes to flick and misses, deflects away for an extra.
googly lands short on seventh stump, toe slapped through cover for one.
full on leg stump, Warner goes to reverse slog this and top edges this over silly point for a single.

googly lands on a good length on off stump, Warner backs away trying to go inside out over extra cover but gets this lower off the bat nearer the toe. Simple chance taken by Jaiswal at chest height. But hang on... Jaiswal is a bit lazy standing two yards outside the 30-yard circle at the time the ball was released. So a no-ball is being called for a fielding restriction violation. Warner will return to the field to face it and have his innings continue.
another short ball on the stumps pulled to deep midwicket for two.
short on the stumps, pulled to deep midwicket for two.
good length ball flicked away for one to get off the mark.
length ball floated a foot outside leg stump, Warner reverse sweeps/switch hits this high over extra cover for two. A third run is taken on a sloppy collection from the relay.
full on middle, reaches forward in front of his pads to defend to midwicket.
fullish length on fourth stump, reaches forward with hard hands and an inside edge goes into the pads for none.
good length ball on off, prods at this and a thick edge goes wide of slip for none.

full on the stumps, Powell tries to slog this but gets more wrists than biceps behind this shot trying to adjust to the spin on the carrom ball. It goes high to deep midwicket and a safe catch is taken two yards inside the rope by Hetmyer at chest height.
good length ball hit down the ground for one.

full on seventh stump, drives this through wide extra cover and beats the sweeper's diving effort to the rope. Warner brings up his 61st 50-plus score in the IPL, 57 50s and 4 centuries.  It comes off 44 balls though... Required run rate is nearly 18 per over.
short and wide, sliced behind point and they take two ahead of the relay from the sweeper.
charges down the stumps to a ball dragged much wider outside off and with the length pulled back too. Axar gets nowhere remotely close to this and flails in vain missing badly. Simple stumping.
full and well outside leg, misses a sweep and wide is called.
full on the stumps, sweeps this to deep midwicket for one.
length ball on fifth stump, slapped back to Chahal who misfields this through his legs to mid-on for one.
short on the stumps, pulled to deep midwicket for one.
full and well outside leg stump, goes to sweep and misses off the pads before trickling to fine leg for an extra.
full outside leg stump, flicked through wide midwicket to the rope.
127 kph delivery full on middle, jammed out back to the bowler for none.
full on fifth stump, driven to long-on for one.
length ball on fifth stump, slapped to extra cover for none.
fullish length on middle, flicked to midwicket for none.
full on fourth stump, driven to long-off for one.

drag on! Fullish length ball angled in from around the wicket on fourth stump, Yadav goes for a big heave over midwicket and inside edges this onto his pads before it caroms back gently onto middle stump.
length ball on sixth stump, spanked on the up flat over mid-off, one bounce over the rope.

slower length ball on the stumps, pulled to deep square leg for a jogged single. Samson appeals pretty wildly for a runout after receiving the relay. Hmmm.... 30 seconds of our lives we'll never get back. Third umpire referral clearly shows the bat was comfortably in....
length ball on sixth stump, slices at this and misses.
knee high full toss on eighth stump, slaps this to the cover sweeper for one.
full on leg stump, Warner digs this out to long-on for one.
full on the stumps, driven to long-on for one.
good length ball on fourth stump, opens the face to run this to third man for one.
full on fifth stump, flicked to wide long-on for two.
full on the stumps, driven to long-on for one.
good length ball on fourth stump, prodded into the covers for one.

bouncer on the stumps, top edges a pull over the keeper to the fine leg rope. If you're being generous, you could say he swiveled inside the line and played that intentionally rather than a top edge. Either way, the runs all count.
good length ball on middle, gets on a knee to pull this to deep midwicket for two.
full on leg stump, sweeps this firmly to deep square leg for one.
full on middle, goes for the reverse sweep again and gets it much squarer this time in front of point but still has enough power on it to beat the sweeper.
good length ball floated well outside off turning past the guideline, left alone and wide called.
fullish length ball on seventh stump, Lalit premeditates a reverse sweep and nails this high over short third man to the rope.
short outside leg, keeps a touch low as he pulls to deep midwicket for one.
fullish length ball on the legs, sweeps this to deep square leg for two.
good length ball on the legs, flicked into midwicket for one.
good length ball sliding down the leg side again, another wide called.
good length ball on fifth stump, defended to extra cover for none.
good length ball sliding well past leg stump, wide called.
good length ball on the legs, flicked through midwicket for one.
full on fifth stump, driven to long-off for one.
fullish length ball flicked away for one.
good length ball chipped loosely wide of Ashwin for one.
full and speared into middle and leg, flicked out to wide long-on for two.
length ball on fifth stump, exquisite back foot punch square of the wicket beats point in the ring and the sweeper to the rope.
back of a length on the stumps, tapped into midwicket for one.
short on the legs, pulled fine past deep backward square leg to the rope to bring up 6,000 IPL runs for Warner.
full and very wide near the guideline, slices a drive over backward point to deep third man for one.
back of a length on the legs, flicked into midwicket for one.
full on the stumps, jammed out into the covers for one.
back of a length ball on sixth stump, pulled to wide midwicket for one.
knee high full toss on seventh stump, slapped to wide long-off for one and Warner slams his pads in frustration after reaching the non-striker's end.
full on the stumps, flicked through wide long-on for one.
full outside leg stump, flicked to midwicket for one.
good length ball on the stumps, punched down the ground for one.
fullish length on the stumps, prodded down the ground for one.
good length ball on the stumps, flicked to long-on for one.
full on sixth stump, drives flat to long-off for one.
good length ball on the stumps, uses his feet coming down the track and pokes a leading edge just short of Chahal.
full on the stumps, defended back to the bowler.
full on the stumps, driven to long-on for one.
good length ball on middle, flicked through midwicket for two.
full on sixth stump, drives firmly to cover for none.

full on fourth stump, Rossouw goes for one of his bread and butter reverse sweeps, but this comes off more of a toe/cue shot that floats gently to cover on the ring. Sharp catch taken at ankle height diving forward by Jaiswal, who is having a terrific all-round match. Rossouw wanted to play that much more squarer than he did.
full on middle, shuffles across to flick this high and wide of square leg for two.
length ball on fifth stump, slaps this wide of extra cover for one.
good length ball slanted down the leg side past a pull, wide called.
good length ball on off, defended.
length ball on sixth stump, plenty of width to attack and flay this high over backward point to the rope.
bouncer over middle stump, left alone. Wide called on height.
full on fifth stump, jammed out to extra cover for a tight single.
short on sixth stump, slaps a cut straight to cover for none.
back of a length on fifth stump, seams sharply away to beat Warner poking away from his body.
half-volley on fourth stump, Warner pumps a drive flat over mid-off, one bounce over the rope.
angled in sharply on a good length on off stump, cramps Rossouw trying to punch this off the back foot and an inside edge comes off the body before a carom in front of point for one.
good length ball zinged in on leg stump following Warner backing away, slapped to Ashwin's right and he fumbles a collection to allow this to go to mid-off for one.
good length ball on off, goes back to punch to long-on for one.
short on off, Warner pounces on the length and pulls flat through wide mid-on to the rope.
flighted on a good length on off, defended.
good length ball on fourth stump, defended to cover.
slants this in sharply on middle, defended.
full on off, defended to mid-on for none.
134 kph good length ball, defended to mid-on for none.
length ball on sixth stump, slapped to extra cover for none.
fullish length ball on fifth stump, punched through extra cover to the rope.
length ball on middle, flicked behind square leg for one.

nearly a third wicket for Boult! Barely eludes backward point's leaping effort! Length ball swinging away from fifth stump, Rossouw goes to drive and slices this loosely but it's just beyond Hetmyer on the ring and goes to the rope.
fullish length on seventh stump, drives this to cover on the ring for none.
126 kph back of a length on fourth stump, pulled authoritatively through wide mid-on to the rope.
gem! Good length ball on fourth stump seams away to beat a forward prod.
full outside leg stump, half-volley really but it's flicks straight to midwicket for none. Sums up Delhi's start so far.
127 kph delivery full on middle, defended to extra cover for none.
good length ball seams away sharply from fifth stump, Warner leaves it upon seeing the sharp movement at 136 kph.
good length ball well down the leg side, wide called for Delhi's first run of the chase.
good length ball on middle at 138 kph, defended back down the pitch to Boult. Double-wicket maiden to start the chase.
beauty! But no wicket! Fullish length on fourth stump swinging away at 137 kph, Rossouw prods forward defensively and is beaten by the away shape.

full and swinging into middle, Pandey is hit low on the shins after he misses a flick and this is stone dead. Pandey turns and walks away before the umpire raises the finger. Warner has a chat with him to cajole him into using a review.  Pandey's entire body language shows he knew he was very out. This is going to rub salt into the wound. No way was this missing the stumps. Indeed three full reds show up on ball-tracking with the ball crashing into leg stump after hitting him in front of middle. Delhi lose a review and Boult is on a hat-trick.

sensational one-handed catch from Samson! Full on fourth stump, Shaw goes to flick through mid-on, Samson is wrong-footed initially but recovers to fling himself to his right in front of slip and clings onto a low chance at shin height.
back of a length ball on off, sticks in the wicket a touch as Shaw is through the shot a touch early flicking to midwicket and is struck on the back thigh.
back of a length swinging into the body on middle, flicked to short backward square leg/leg gully for none.
